summary: Warn operators when a due schedule tick remains replication-blocked for fifteen minutes.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill; warning timing is a local monotonic observation.

schema.detail: Uses existing operational.failure and operational.recovered attention; no new stored-state schema.

rules.detail: No admission, catch-up, takeover, replication or retention rules change.

compatibility.detail: Existing operator attention can contain one replication-blocked tick warning per schedule and observing host, naming peer comparisons and counts.

downtime.detail: No deployment or live-state changes included.

manual.detail: No action required; warning recovery follows gate recovery, stop or a placement change away from this member.

recovery.detail: Restart begins a new fifteen-minute observation window. Short intervals do not reset the first blocked tick; declaration revisions and replicated completion retire the old observation.
